title: Weak continuity of pulled-back covector integrands (weak continuity of Jacobian minors, parent step (f))
statement: Let k, Q ∈ ℕ, Ω ⊆ ℝ^k (= Eucl k) open, ψ : ℝ^k → ℝ Lebesgue-integrable on Ω, α : ℝ^Q → Covector (Eucl Q) k (k-covectors on ℝ^Q) continuous with compact support, C ≥ 0, and let u_j : ℝ^k → ℝ^Q (j ∈ ℕ) and u₀ : ℝ^k → ℝ^Q all be C-Lipschitz on Ω, with u_j → u₀ uniformly on Ω. Then ∫_Ω ψ(w)·α(u_j(w))(∂_0u_j(w), …, ∂_{k−1}u_j(w)) dw → ∫_Ω ψ(w)·α(u₀(w))(∂_0u₀(w), …, ∂_{k−1}u₀(w)) dw as j → ∞, where ∂_bv(w) := fderiv ℝ v w (EuclideanSpace.single b 1) is the b-th partial derivative (Mathlib fderiv, equal to 0 where v is not differentiable) and dw is Lebesgue measure (volume).
lean_statement: ∀ (k Q : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)) (ψ : Eucl k → ℝ) (α : Eucl Q → Covector (Eucl Q) k) (C : ℝ≥0) (u : ℕ → Eucl k → Eucl Q) (u₀ : Eucl k → Eucl Q), IsOpen Ω → IntegrableOn ψ Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl k)) → Continuous α → HasCompactSupport α → (∀ j, LipschitzOnWith C (u j) Ω) → LipschitzOnWith C u₀ Ω → TendstoUniformlyOn u u₀ atTop Ω → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ w in Ω, ψ w * α (u j w) (fun b => fderiv ℝ (u j) w (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in Ω, ψ w * α (u₀ w) (fun b => fderiv ℝ u₀ w (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))))
